pattern: drive this thread from a chat app
experience: The user wants their Telegram chat to drive the thread they are in. The agent finds the chat with messaging_chats and binds it with messaging_bind, leaving threadId out so the calling thread is used.
rule: messaging_bind: When the user asks, bind a chat from messaging_chats to a thread so their messages there become turns on it and its approvals reach them, or unbind it (unbind=true).

source.note: New messaging tools (CMDeck WI-3.01); no prior text to regress from.

messaging_bind.message: Bound. Messages in that chat now start turns on the thread.

prompt: Hook my Telegram chat up to this thread so I can keep going from my phone.

pattern: stop a chat app driving a thread
experience: Asked to stop Telegram messages reaching a thread, the agent unbinds the chat with messaging_bind unbind=true instead of binding it elsewhere.
